If the foci of the ellipse $\dfrac{x^2}{25} + \dfrac{y^2}{k^2} = 1\ (k^2 < 25)$ and the hyperbola $\dfrac{x^2}{k} - \dfrac{y^2}{5} = 1$ are same then the product of the length of the latus rectum of the ellipse and that of hyperbola is
solution:
Ellipse foci $(\pm\sqrt{25 - k^2}, 0)$; hyperbola foci $(\pm\sqrt{5 + k}, 0)$.

$5 + k = 25 - k^2 \Rightarrow (k+5)(k-4) = 0 \Rightarrow k = 4$

Product $= \dfrac{2k^2}{5}\times\dfrac{2\times5}{\sqrt k} = \dfrac{32}{5}\times5 = 32$
